evidence.title: HOVERSTAT.ES | The home of alternative web-design.

name: HOVERSTAT.ES
summary: Curated showcase of alternative web design: sites experimenting with interactions, typography and code, archived since 2012.
description: A curated gallery of websites that experiment with design, interactivity and content, published since 2012 by Mike Guppy and Dan Powell. Each feature gives the site's URL, date and a short write-up of what it does (SVG typography animation, timeline navigation, hover toggles …) with a video preview and credits; visitors can browse the archive or submit a site.
contains: curated web design archive running since 2012
feature pages with date, write-up and credits for each site
